title: 3 Day Budget Uganda Safari: Murchison Falls
rank_math_title: Budget Uganda Safari: 3 Days in Murchison Falls
rank_math_desc: Budget Uganda safari for 3 days: rhino tracking at Ziwa on the way, game drives in Murchison Falls National Park, a Nile boat trip and the top of the falls.
post_content: This budget Uganda safari shows you Murchison Falls National Park, Uganda's largest park, in three days from Kampala.
overview:
This budget Uganda safari shows you Murchison Falls National Park, Uganda's largest park, in three days from Kampala. Stop to track white rhinos on foot at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary on the way, then enjoy a game drive on the northern savannah, a boat trip up the Nile to the foot of the falls, and a walk to the top of Murchison Falls where the river forces its way through a narrow gorge. You stay at the simple Red Chilli Rest Camp inside the park.

Price: from USD 570 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Rhino tracking on foot at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary
Game drive for giraffes, elephants and lions
Boat trip on the Nile to the foot of Murchison Falls
Hike to the top of the falls

faq.q: When is the best time for Murchison Falls?
faq.a: December to February and June to September are the driest months for game drives.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Kampala to Murchison Falls
itinerary.content: Morning drive north with a stop at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary to track white rhinos on foot. Continue to Murchison Falls National Park. Dinner and overnight at Red Chilli Rest Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Game drive and Nile boat trip
itinerary.content: Early crossing of the Nile for a game drive on the northern bank, then an afternoon boat trip to the foot of the falls. Dinner and overnight at Red Chilli Rest Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Top of the falls and return to Kampala
itinerary.content: Visit the top of Murchison Falls, then drive back to Kampala in the afternoon.

includes: Shared safari vehicle with English-speaking driver guide
Accommodation and meals at Red Chilli Rest Camp
Park entry fees, Nile boat trip and Ziwa rhino tracking
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
